title: Prove structure-dependent shear perturbation bounds (no new kappa)
body:
Coefficient errors that preserve elementary-shear support cannot make a gate singular, even when the total interaction error is at least one. This scoped proof gives finite ordered-product bounds for every forward/inverse prefix, both operator defects, and additive arithmetic noise. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd33c723408bb98875211ee3145582c507881f29/research/shear-structure-perturbation/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd33c723408bb98875211ee3145582c507881f29/research/shear-structure-perturbation/verify.py), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/cd33c723408bb98875211ee3145582c507881f29/research/shear-structure-perturbation/SOURCES.json) are at the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7. [The claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19149211) records the overlap scope.

For exact gates `I+a_i N_i` and changed gates `I+(a_i+e_i)N_i`, with `N_i^2=0`, each interaction error is also square-zero. Both its forward and inverse factors have norm at most `1+||D_i||`. Thus `P_j=product_(i<=j)(1+||D_i||)` controls the ordered products without the general-error condition `sum ||D_i||<1`. Structural zeros and diagonal ones must be retained. This is a sufficient bound, not a sharp bound or a claim that rounded grid instructions are reversible.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal/optimized replay passed 24 circuits, 192 prefixes, 192 noisy steps, 16 circuits with interaction sum at least one, and five controls. Direct normal/optimized CPython 3.14.7 runs also passed. The checker computes literal inverse matrices by rational Gaussian elimination. Committed-byte comparison and direct base ancestry passed. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable because this checkout is shallow.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shear-structure-perturbation
```

Expected markers: `PASS_SHEAR_PERTURBATION` in both modes and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39983657784](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39983657784). No selected cold replay, native replay, compiler build, Lean build, or Docker run was used. A production coefficient policy, prefix envelope, arithmetic kernel, overflow bound, physical costs, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit ywz65's [PR #2701](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2701) for the interaction-coordinate and general noise contract, Vlado Vojdanovski's [PR #1673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1673) for the circuit/precision context, and Nick Petalas's [PR #5153](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5153) for the distinct endpoint-norm refinement. Classical nilpotent inverse and product estimates are retained. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.
